mappings.product_miss: The same student_csn public journey covered weeks and summer study but had no focused own-sickness route, allowing study-support sickness, gymnasium, studies abroad, parallel work and VAB to be missed or conflated.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep the same actor_type=student and focus=student_csn route and add topic=sickness. Reuse explicit coarse study_context/study_work when present, otherwise ask only route-changing questions. VAB and non-personal research contexts must not be stolen by the own-sickness route.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Current CSN and Försäkringskassan primary sources carry material rules. The public product must not decide entitlement, amount, SGI, medical work/study capacity, certificate requirement, exact deadline or employer responsibility from free text.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Public handoff may contain only actor_type=student, focus=student_csn, language, topic=sickness and optional coarse study_context/study_work. Never place diagnosis, SGI, medical certificate, employer identity, exact income, identity or raw story in URL or structured feedback.
